answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 8743 Country: India Title: Assalam walekum, I had been told by one mufti that any colour dye can be use in hair and beard exept black.Can you help me in this regard. Question: Assalam walekum, I had been told by one mufti that any colour dye can be use in hair and beard exept black.Can you help me in this regard. Answer ID: 8743 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1451/1218=L/1429) The Mufti sahib is right. Using dye of colours other than black is lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
